sentences.text: Estelle Getty -LRB- née Scher ; also known as Estelle Gettleman ; July 25 , 1923 -- July 22 , 2008 -RRB- was an American actress and comedian , who appeared in film , television , and theatre .	née	given names	actress	actress	film	film	television	television	theatre	theatre
